No global toggle in _Layout.cshtml. The prior 'eye' grep hits were only vendored bootstrap/jquery bundles.
gap: Add an eye toggle button + small JS to switch input type on Login, ChangePassword (also covers forced first-change), and ResetPassword views.

title: Auth & Security
requirement: TFA optional (email/phone code)
evidence: Email TFA confirmed: SendTwoFactorCodeAsync (AccountController.cs:382-404) generates a 6-digit code, stores CodeHash with expiry, and sends via _emailService.SendAsync template 'TwoFactorCode' ONLY. Gated by global SystemConstant 'TfaEmailEnabled' (IsTfaEnabledAsync:406-413; seeded SeedData.cs:114). No SMS/phone channel: grep for sms/phone TFA yields nothing in the TFA path; User.cs:23 has an unused Phone field. No per-user TFA opt-in field on User (grep Tfa|TwoFactor on User.cs = no matches).
gap: Only the email channel exists. No phone/SMS code path. The toggle is a single global system constant, not per-user opt-in.

title: Auth & Security
requirement: Session auto-logout after 30 min inactivity; 30 must be a configurable parameter
evidence: Re-verified: Program.cs:93-94 sets ExpireTimeSpan = TimeSpan.FromHours(8) with SlidingExpiration = true (sliding-inactivity mechanism present). Value is hardcoded — appsettings.json has no timeout/session key (grep = no matches) and there is no session-timeout SystemConstant (only 'TfaEmailEnabled' exists in Data/SeedData).
gap: Timeout is 8 hours, not 30 minutes, and is hardcoded. Change to 30 min and bind it to a configurable parameter (appsettings key or SystemConstant).

title: Auth & Security
requirement: Forced change-password screen must NOT be bypassable by clicking the menu
evidence: Re-verified: the only globally registered filter is RequireTermsAcceptedFilter (Program.cs:36), and it checks Terms acceptance only, explicitly whitelisting 'ChangePassword' in ExemptActions (RequireTermsAcceptedFilter.cs:19-30). No other global IActionFilter/IMiddleware exists (grep across Web = only that filter + vendored choices.js). MustChangePassword/IsPasswordExpired are enforced solely at login-time redirect (AccountController.cs:184 and PostLoginRedirect :456), so an authenticated user sitting on ChangePassword can click any menu link and reach other pages.
gap: Add a global action filter (mirroring the Terms filter) that redirects any authenticated user with MustChangePassword==true or an expired password to ChangePassword, exempting only account/logout actions.

title: Auth & Security
requirement: Forgot-password email flow works and email is actually received; reset link not broken/wrapped in Outlook
evidence: Flow re-verified: ForgotPassword (AccountController.cs:257-316) creates URL-safe token, stores SHA256 hash with expiry, builds an ABSOLUTE link via Url.Action(nameof(ResetPassword),...,Request.Scheme) (:283), sends 'PasswordReset' template, and logs a NotificationLog (incl. 'Skipped' for unknown/no-email users); generic Hebrew message is account-enumeration-safe. Outlook link-wrapping half of the gap is DISPROVEN: EmailTemplateRenderer.FormatBodyHtml (lines 43-61) auto-linkifies any token whose key ends with 'Link' (ResetLink qualifies) into a proper clickable anchor: ... (line 56).
gap: Only remaining unknown is actual SMTP/mail delivery, which is environment/config-dependent and not verifiable from code. The reset link is already rendered as a clickable anchor, so no template change is needed for the Outlook concern.

title: Auth & Security
requirement: After forgot-password link change, must NOT immediately re-force another change / must not allow same password
evidence: Re-verified: same-password/history reuse IS blocked in ResetPassword POST (AccountController.cs:359-365) via VerifyPassword against current hash AND IsPasswordInHistoryAsync (last 5). But line 369 sets user.MustChangePassword = true after a user-chosen reset, so at next login PostLoginRedirect (:456) forces ANOTHER change — violating the 'must not re-force' half.
gap: Since the user already chose their own password via the reset link, set user.MustChangePassword = false at AccountController.cs:369 so they are not forced to change again at next login. (Note: this is the opposite of the admin-reset flow, which should keep MustChangePassword=true.)

title: Reporting Form (Online)
requirement: No exceeding 9 daily hours unless ללא הגבלה
evidence: ReportValidationService.cs:196-203: for a row WITH an AllocationId the method loads the allocation and at lines 200-201 `if (allocation != null && !allocation.DailyEmploymentScope.HasValue) return;` — it exits with NO limit applied. But ValidateSubmit (line 105-106) forces every row to have an AllocationId, so the 9h default is never applied to a real allocation whose DailyEmploymentScope is NULL — such an allocation is effectively treated as unlimited. title: Reporting Form (Online)

evidence: Beta doc line 275 ('שדה להעלאת מסמכים ברמת עובד וברמת דיווח ולתת חיווי') and [F40]/line 51 ('בשורה של ההקצאה לדיווח לצרף שדה מסמכים ומשם ניתן לצפות במסמכים ברמה של עובד'). DocumentAttachment.cs has UserId (per-employee) and ReportRowId. ReportController.Index (lines 130-135) surfaces report-level AND row-level attachments, and the report screen lists/deletes them (Index.cshtml 191-252). BUT UploadAttachment (ReportController.cs:551-561) sets ReportId only — no per-row upload UI, and employee-level (UserId) documents are never queried or shown on the report screen (the 131-135 query filters on ReportId or ReportRowId only).
gap: Add per-row upload UI and surface/indicate employee-level (UserId) documents within the report screen; currently only report-level upload exists and per-employee docs live solely on the employee card.

title: Reporting Form (Online)
requirement: Let employee download their own report as Excel (TEST Sheet7 #4)
evidence: Confirmed against 'בדיקת פרויקט דיווח פעילות (6).txt' [Q5]: 'לתת לעובד אפשרות להוריד באקסל את הדיווח שלו'. The report screen offers only DownloadExcelTemplate (ReportController.cs:188-221, empty template, English headers) and UploadExcel — no export of the employee's own report ROWS. The only employee-facing XLWorkbook export is MyAllocationsController.ExportExcel (lines 69-113) which exports the ALLOCATIONS list (פרויקט/תוכנית/scopes), not report rows. Dashboard Excel export is gated by CanViewDashboard (Program.cs) which excludes role 6/Employee.
gap: Add an Excel export of the employee's own report rows (Hebrew headers, column order matching the on-screen grid per beta [F24]/[F25]) accessible to the Employee role on the report screen.

title: Excel Upload (report import)
requirement: Mobile-friendly upload screen
evidence: Batch upload is a fully responsive Bootstrap card with full-width controls (Views/Admin/BatchReportImport.cshtml:27-53: form-select, form-control, btn-primary, all block-level). Single-report upload parent is a wrapping flex row (Views/Report/Index.cshtml:332 d-flex flex-wrap gap-2), template link + form wrap on narrow widths. Inner upload form (Report/Index.cshtml:344-352) uses d-flex gap-2 align-items-center with form-control-sm file input + btn-sm.
gap: No dedicated mobile-optimized upload screen. The employee single-upload file input + submit button sit in an inner d-flex WITHOUT flex-wrap (Report/Index.cshtml:344), so on very narrow screens the file picker and button do not stack; they rely on being btn-sm/form-control-sm to fit. Batch screen is genuinely mobile-friendly; single-report inline control is only adequately responsive. No evidence of mobile-width verification.

title: Excel Upload (report import)
requirement: Overwrite only unapproved reports
evidence: Single import correctly guards: ReportExcelImportService.cs:55-59 returns error when StatusId is 3 (PendingApproval) or 4 (Approved), then removes+replaces only that allocation's rows (lines 117-131). CanEditReport also blocks 3/4 in the controller (ReportController.cs:611). Batch path: BatchReportImportService.cs:355-376 find-or-creates the user's report and appends candidate rows; a grep for StatusId across the whole batch service returns ONLY two hits (line 364 create-as-InEntry, line 375 flip 1->2). No check for StatusId 3 or 4 anywhere in the batch flow (verified rows 240-399).
gap: Batch import does NOT block appending to an Approved (StatusId 4) or PendingApproval (StatusId 3) report. Lines 371-376 only reset ImportedFromExcel/UpdatedAt and flip StatusId 1->2; an already-approved report keeps StatusId 4 while new rows are appended (line 389). This violates rule 11 'Excel upload overwrites ONLY unapproved reports' for the multi-employee batch path. Fix: add the same StatusId is 3 or 4 guard (skip/reject the row) in the batch persist loop.

title: Dashboard (reports)
requirement: Cascading filters; choosing מחוז surfaces all related values across fields
evidence: FilterOptions AJAX / GetCompatibleOptionsAsync exists only in Summary.cshtml, DashboardController.FilterOptions (DashboardController.cs:49-71), and tests — grep confirms Index.cshtml has NO FilterOptions/data-live-filter/Scripts section. Index is a plain GET form. DashboardController.PopulateFilterDataAsync (DashboardController.cs:220-249) only server-side cascades Sectors/Programs by DistrictId (lines 225-228); the other ~15 lookups (Localities, Frameworks, Domains, Subjects, DiscussionCodes, Classes, GradeLevels, ReportTypes, ConclusionLocations) are loaded unconditionally (239-248) and never cascade.
gap: On the primary reports dashboard, choosing מחוז does not dynamically narrow the full dropdown set; only sector/program cascade and only server-side on הצג. Wire the already-built FilterOptions AJAX into Index.cshtml and extend cascading to the allocation-dimension lookups.

title: Dashboard (reports)
requirement: Table empty until 'הצג' pressed; pressing 'הצג' with nothing selected must not error
evidence: DashboardController.Index (DashboardController.cs:36) hard-codes 'var showData = true;' so GetReportRowsAsync always runs and the grid loads on first render. The 'show=1' hidden input (Index.cshtml:93) is ignored by the controller. The empty-selection no-error behavior is fine (returns all scoped rows, no throw), but the spec'd empty-until-הצג behavior is not honored.
gap: Gate initial load on a submitted flag (e.g. honor the show=1 param) so the results grid stays empty until הצג is pressed. Currently it eagerly loads all scoped data.

title: Lookup Tables / Admin
requirement: Frameworks table: שם מסגרת/סמל columns, symbol unique per stage, duplicate error, search by name/symbol/stage/locality, import+export Excel, bulk active/inactive toggle
evidence: AdminController.Frameworks/CreateFramework/EditFramework (src/AxiomaReporting.Web/Controllers/AdminController.cs:191-275) enforce InstitutionSymbol unique per EducationalStageId with Hebrew duplicate error ('סמל מוסד זה כבר קיים עבור שלב חינוך זה') plus a DbUpdateException catch. Views/Admin/Frameworks.cshtml lists תיאור / סמל מוסד / שלב חינוך (35-37) and add/edit modals. Excel IMPORT exists only via ImportFrameworksAsync (AdminController.cs:1344, called at 802 from the combined data-migration importer, sheet 'מסגרות').
gap: Confirmed absent after re-reading the full view and controller: Frameworks.cshtml has NO search/filter form (only a plain table; contrast Views/Lookup/List.cshtml:46-71 which does have one), so no search by name/symbol/stage/locality — and Framework.cs has no locality field at all (grep for Locality/ישוב in Framework.cs = no matches). No Excel EXPORT action for frameworks (grep ExportFramework = none). No bulk active/inactive toggle — only per-row edit modal checkbox (Frameworks.cshtml:149-152). Import is buried in the data-migration tool, not offered on the frameworks screen.

title: Lookup Tables / Admin

ProjectProgram.cs is purely a ProjectId↔ProgramId join (4 scalar members, no lookup-value FKs).
